classification_order.rule: Normalized token equals a protected-taxonomy value, or equals a target-schema-declared alias whose mapped value is a protected taxonomy value.
Token is not L0_DIRECT; it matches one or more registered exact carrier columns, and every matched carrier yields the same protected target value.
Token is not L0_DIRECT and matches registered carriers that imply different protected target values.
Token is not L0_DIRECT and matches no registered exact carrier.

important_semantics: UNVERIFIED is not evidence of non-determination.
A domain with no declared taxonomy transform is not NONDETERMINED.
No cross-row, multi-column, fuzzy, learned, or manually curated derivation is permitted.
Taxonomy-exhaustive=false means unmatched values remain UNVERIFIED.
The audit reports all six registered queries and all fourteen gold-mapped source columns.

steps: collapse one-or-more Unicode whitespace characters to one ASCII space

protected_query_semantics: For each taxonomy-backed target attribute, q asks for the canonical target taxonomy value represented by the frozen target taxonomy column.

breadth_qualification_rule.reporting: All registered queries and all gold-mapped source columns are reported whatever the outcome.

never_permitted: Keep only domains with favorable L1 results.
Add an alias or delimiter parser after inspecting source values.
Change the protected target or carrier set after audit results.
Describe a structurally unregistered domain as evidence against derivability.

nontrivial_L1_query_definition.note: A domain qualifies when one of its queries meets both thresholds; the thresholds are frozen before any source value is read and change no measurement.

scientific_execution_requirements.products_and_papers: retain as structural no-registered-transform domains; do not infer non-determination

source_scope: Only source columns with positive gold schema mappings to the protected target attribute are audited. All such mappings are included.
taxonomy_authority_note: HAS_DECLARED_TAXONOMY_AUTHORITY is not evidence of leakage, derivability, or audit success; the authority extraction computes no external verdict.

tokenization.CSV_string: audit the whole cell as one token
tokenization.JSON_encoded_list_inside_string: do not parse or split; audit as one scalar string
tokenization.native_JSON_array: audit each scalar array element independently
tokenization.reason: Conservative pre-result rule prevents result-driven parsing of source-specific delimiters.
